items.item:
1. In a log whose entries are all older than today, erasing before today
   leaves exactly the new erasure entry.
   Shows A15-2. [witness: verification:registry_a15_erase_before_today_leaves_only_own_entry]
statements: erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2

verdicts.item:
1. In a log whose entries are all older than today, erasing before today
   leaves exactly the new erasure entry.
   Shows A15-2. [witness: verification:registry_a15_erase_before_today_leaves_only_own_entry]
statements: erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2
verdicts.why: The check creates three DAY_0 entries, accepts an erasure before DAY_1, and verifies both the public log and persisted rows contain exactly one entry: the new accepted erasure entry recorded on DAY_1. Thus no entry older than the start of DAY_1 remains.
